objectives: 本課程幫助學生了解能源使用、科技發展與環境永續之間的關係。課程提供有關不同能源來源的重要知識，包括化石燃料、核能以及再生能源，同時探討它們對空氣、水資源、氣候與生態系統所造成的環境影響。透過本課程，學生能夠以科學角度理解當前全球能源挑戰，例如氣候變遷、污染以及資源耗竭等問題。課程也鼓勵學生對能源節約、永續發展以及未來能源政策進行批判性思考。此外，本課程幫助學生認識在經濟成長與環境保護之間取得平衡的重要性。透過學習這些概念，學生能更加了解自己作為全球公民及未來專業人才所肩負的責任，並有能力為社會發展更潔淨、更安全且更永續的能源解決方案作出貢獻。
content:
1.	Energy Fundamentals, Energy Use in an Industrial Society
a.	Energy Basics (Forms of Energy)
b.	Units of Energy
c.	Energy Consumption
d.	The Principle of Energy Conservation
e.	Renewable and Nonrenewable Energy Sources
2.	The Fossil Fuels
a.	Coal (The Formation of Coal, Coal Resources and Consumption)
b.	Petroleum (History of t Petroleum, Petroleum Refining Process)
c.	Natural Gas (History of Natural Gas, Natural Gas Refining Process)
3.	Heat Engines
a.	The Mechanical Equivalent of Heat
b.	The Energy Content of Fuels
c.	The Thermodynamics of Heat Engines
d.	Generation of Electricity
e.	Electric Power Transmission
f.	Practical Heat Engines (Steam Engines, Gasoline Engines, Diesel Engines, Gas Turbines)
4.	Renewable Energy Sources I: Solar Energy
a.	Energy from the Sun
b.	Principle of Photovoltaic cell
c.	A Flat-Plate Collector System
d.	Passive Solar
e.	Solar Thermal Electric Power Generation
5.	Renewable Energy Sources II: Alternatives
a.	Hydropower
b.	Wind Power
c.	Ocean Thermal Energy Conversion
d.	Biomass as an Energy Feedstock
e.	Biomass: Municipal Solid Waste
f.	Biomass-Derived Liquid and Gaseous Fuels
g.	Geothermal Energy
h.	Tidal Energy
i.	Wave Energy
6.	The Promise and Problems of Nuclear Energy
a.	History of Nuclear Energy
b.	Radioactivity
c.	Nuclear Reactors
d.	The Boiling Water Reactor
e.	Fuel Cycle
f.	Uranium Resources
g.	Environmental and Safety Aspects of Nuclear Energy
h.	Nuclear Reactor Accidents (Chernobyl, Fukushima Daiichi,
i.	The Storage of High-Level Radioactive Waste
j.	The Cost of Nuclear Power
k.	A Fusion Reactor
7.	Energy storage
a.	Thermal energy storage
b.	Chemical energy storage (Reversible Chemical Reactions)
c.	Energy Storage in Organic Fuels
d.	Mechanical Energy Storage
e.	Electromagnetic Energy Storage
f.	Hydrogen Storage
g.	Lead-Acid Batteries
h.	Lithium Systems
i.	Energy Storage for Medium- to Large-Scale Applications
8.	Green transportation
a.	Electric Vehicles
b.	Hydrogen, Fuel Cells
c.	Alcohol as a Transportation Fuel
d.	Hybrid Vehicles
e.	Mass Transportation
books:
Energy and the Environment,  Robert A. Ristinen, Jack J. Kraushaar, Jeffrey T. Brack
ISBN: 978-1-119-80025-5
